subject: SparrowBank - coordination for feature slot & escrow path
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: SparrowBank — request: carve out feature slot + escrow path for procurement

Team — quick ask to align on prioritization and scope for SparrowBank (Strategic Enterprise, procurement deadline 7/31). We just received an ask from Rachel (SparrowBank) to guarantee a narrow feature delivery window and an escrow path if we can’t meet a hard milestone. Key context:
- Account: SparrowBank (regional commercial bank) — high ARR, will reference Redwood in two upcoming partner briefs.
- Ask: deliver a tenant-affinity cache feature + audit-export hook (MVP) that reduces warm-up latencies for heavy trading flows. They want a 30-day staged delivery starting 8/15, with a fallback escrow (exported model weights/configs + forensic logs) if we cannot meet the SLA.
- Why this matters: procurement requires either a firm delivery milestone or escrow assurances to clear legal. Sales needs the product slot to close the deal this quarter.

Attachments: sparrow_mvp_spec.pdf (draft scope), sb_commercial_summary.xlsx (deal economics).

Asks for product/eng:
1) Can engineering commit to a gated delivery milestone (start 8/15) for a scoped MVP that includes the cache-affinity toggle + a lightweight audit-export API? If not, what minimal escrow bundle would satisfy legal (what files/logs + how long to prepare)?
2) Estimates: rough dev + QA delta (weeks), risk areas, and whether we need a dedicated sprint slot or scope-reduction.

Marissa — can you advise on the minimum acceptance criteria for product? Ben — need your early feasibility read. Laura — CS/Onboarding, what operational support would be required if we do a staged delivery?

Thanks — short timeline here, procurement pushes next week.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SparrowBank — request: carve out feature slot + escrow path for procurement

Thanks Sean — looping in product and clarifying the acceptance bar. Quick notes from product POV:
- MVP must include:
  * Feature flag for tenant-affinity cache routing (configurable TTL + affinity weight)
  * 1-click audit-export endpoint (time-bounded, JSONL + manifest) that exports request/response traces and model/version metadata for a tenant
  * Basic integration tests and runbook for on-call handoff
- Non-essential for MVP: full UI in Console (can be later), heavy telemetry dashboards (initially token-level CSV export is OK)

Acceptance criteria proposal (minimal):
- Cache-affinity toggles applied and verified in staging with synthetic replay (latency delta < 25% over baseline for warm sessions)
- Audit-export produces complete manifest + logs; export size and privacy filtering documented
- Runbook for operational handoff: rollback steps, data retention notes, owners

Questions for Eng: can we get a dev ETA for a scoped implementation and an estimate for the escrow packaging (what artifacts are in scope — config, model checkpoints, KV-cache snapshot?)

If we can commit to the minimal acceptance criteria by 8/15 for a staged delivery, sales can push procurement to accept staged delivery + milestone credits. If not, procurement will insist on escrow.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior PM, Platform
